Overview

Bridge for Omni Code

Run Omni Code with a self-hosted bridge over HTTP and SSE, with configurable bridge URL, token, and client IDs for your machine or LAN.

Bridge

HTTP for commands, SSE for live updates

The bridge transports messages, session state, approvals, and reply events in a model that is explicit and easy to reason about.

Bridge

Configurable identity and access

Bridge URL, bridge token, and allowed client IDs can be matched to your laptop, local network, or self-hosted environment.

Bridge

Built for local desktop sessions

The bridge is designed to stay close to the machine where the coding agent actually runs.

Next step

Use the client, the bridge, and the workflow together.

Omni Code works best when the desktop agent already runs locally and you want a better remote surface for approval, replies, and voice interaction.
